CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.6
   C. 33
   D. 27.7

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 2/2
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

3. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.7
   C. 31
   D. 31.6

4. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 60
   C. 19
   D. 38

6. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.6
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 22
   C. 15
   D. 30

8. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

9. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 12.5

10. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

11. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 2

12. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
